Entry point `cmd/agent/main.go` supports three modes: single-turn (-p), interactive (no args), subagent-worker (--subagent-worker). Extension points confirmed: tool.Tool interface, ui.UI interface, loop.ModelStreamer, command_registry.go. Dependencies: Go 1.25, bubbletea, lipgloss confirmed in go.mod.
